summary: The new cleanup theorem upgrades top regularity from most to every selected polyad, but the Layer 8 endpoint only consumes `TopRegularOverMostPolyads H' C …`, which `exists_topRegularOverMostPolyads` on main already gives with H' = H and zero edit. The claimed prerequisite path is not real, so this new material has no proximate roadmap target.
